I don’t have direct access to your file system, so I can’t delete or modify files for you. However, here’s a quick way you can clear the contents of `e:\Hackathon\buddy-agent\app\main.py` on Windows:

### Using PowerShell
```powershell
# This overwrites the file with an empty string (clears its contents)
Set-Content -Path "E:\Hackathon\buddy-agent\app\main.py" -Value ""
```

### Using Command Prompt (cmd)
```cmd
type NUL > "E:\Hackathon\buddy-agent\app\main.py"
```

### Using a Python script
```python
# delete_contents.py
file_path = r"E:\Hackathon\buddy-agent\app\main.py"

with open(file_path, "w") as f:
    pass   # opening in write mode truncates the file

print(f"Cleared contents of {file_path}")
```
Run it with:
```cmd
python delete_contents.py
```

Just pick the method you’re most comfortable with, run the command/script, and the file will be emptied. Let me know if you need any more help!
